title: A股港股早报 + 美股盘前：科技负反馈扩散，核电与优质软件抗跌
summary: 美股盘前到盘中延续财报分化：存储和高预期软件被卖，SITM、U、PAYC、CEG 等强反馈标的更适合跟随价格确认。

entries.label: A股港股早报
entries.title: A股港股早报：Sparks资源医药领跑，算力链分化验证
entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
国际
伊朗与阿曼推动霍尔木兹复航谈判，执行条件仍未落地
AP 8月5日报道，伊朗与阿曼正接近一项重开霍尔木兹海峡的安排，但仍取决于美国是否解除对伊朗港口的封锁。事实是谈判预期改善；判断是能源风险溢价有望回落；不确定性在执行时点与航运恢复速度。A/H 关注中海油、油运与航空成本的反向验证。
国际
油价在缓和预期与供应风险之间剧烈拉锯
纽约时段中段，Brent 约 79.72 美元、WTI 约 75.35 美元；AP 指出油价7月曾在 72—102 美元间波动。油价若重新突破日内高位将利好上游能源、压制航空化工；若复航进展兑现，则能源高股息可能转为冲高回落。
科技
Sparks 强势榜由白银、减肥药、超导、CRO 与品牌服饰领跑
Futunn Sparks 08:53 CST 显示白银概念 +6.88%（EXK +7.56%）、减肥药 +3.53%（LLY +4.86%）、室温超导 +3.21%（BRKR +4.31%）、医药外包 +3.08%（CRL +11.36%）、品牌服饰 +2.41%（WEYS +7.18%）。IDC 仍为重要映射线索，排第九、+1.74%（NVDA +3.43%）。A/H 映射为银矿、创新药/CXO、数据中心与算力链，开盘应验证成交额而非机械追高。
科技
AI 网络与芯片内部强弱分化，英伟达/Arista 强而 AMD 承压
美股8月5日收盘道指 +0.5%创高，标普 -0.2%、纳指 -0.8%；Futunn 显示 NVDA +3.43%，公开报道显示 ANET 财报后大涨逾 11%，但 AMD 跌约 7%。这不是半导体全面上攻，A/H 中芯、华虹、存储、服务器与 CPO 链需要以开盘后强于指数、回踩不破为确认信号。
科技
通信服务与平台科技落后，恒生科技权重需防高开回吐
美股盘中 XLC -1.59%、PLTR -1.20%，而上一交易日腾讯 +0.94%、阿里 +1.83%、美团 +0.38%、恒科 +0.97%。港股平台有本地相对强势，但外盘通信服务压力意味着腾讯、阿里必须依靠南向和成交额确认，不能仅凭指数红盘追涨。
科技
光通信相对稳定但未形成独立领涨，CPO 仍看算力链扩散
美股盘中 CIEN -0.07%、GLW -0.27%，显著强于 AMD，但并未随 NVDA 明显上攻。A股映射中际旭创、新易盛、天孚通信；若 CPO 高开后量价背离，说明 IDC 强势尚未有效扩散到光模块，追高风险偏大。
科技
电动车与可选消费信号分裂，整车链暂不具备共振条件
TSLA 盘中 -1.22%，但 XLY +0.16%；上一交易日小米 -1.14%，与恒科整体正收益背离。A/H 电动车、消费电子和智能驾驶更适合观察小米、比亚迪、理想、小鹏能否同步转强，单一个股反弹不足以确认板块轮动。
公告
恒生科技权重与重要 A/H 财报处于可验证空窗
本轮 Futu OpenD HK/SH/SZ 财报日历与 NOTICE 新闻搜索均因本机 OpenD 未启动返回 connection refused；腾讯、阿里、小米官方投资者关系页面抽查也未见8月5日收盘后新发布的核心业绩结果。按规则不以美股财报补位，盘中判断仅基于价格、公开新闻与板块映射。

盘前结论

事实层面，A/H 上一交易日上证约涨 1.47%、恒科约涨 0.97%，中芯与华虹分别约涨 4.14%和 4.74%，本地硬件链已有修复基础；隔夜美股最终呈现道指创新高、纳指回落的分化格局。但隔夜科技并非普涨：NVDA、ANET 上行，AMD、纳指与 XLC 承压，资金更偏向有订单或事件催化的细分方向。

判断层面，今日优先级是白银资源、减肥药、CXO/创新药和 IDC 算力的强势映射；半导体与 CPO 只在中芯、华虹、中际旭创开盘后继续强于指数时跟随；通信服务、平台科技与电动车若成交不足，容易出现高开回吐。

不确定性主要来自霍尔木兹复航条件尚未落地、油价仍高波动，以及隔夜科技内部继续分化；因此所有推演以 A/H 开盘后30分钟量价和南向资金为最终确认，不把盘中快照当作收盘事实。

白银资源 IDC算力 CXO创新药 半导体分化 光通信CPO 平台科技 电动车链 霍尔木兹 油价波动 A股修复 财报空窗 量价验证
利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。

重点个股推荐

药明康德
SH.603259 / HK.02359
CRO映射

推荐理由：Sparks 医药外包 +3.08%，CRL +11.36%，减肥药 +3.53%，海外医药情绪是当日最明确的 A/H 映射之一。

触发因素：A/H 两地开盘后同步强于各自医药指数，且成交额明显放大。

风险点：海外单股财报或事件不等于国内订单改善，若高开低走应停止追价。

盛达资源
SZ.000603
白银映射

推荐理由：白银概念 +6.88%居 Sparks 首位，EXK +7.56%，资源价格映射直接。

触发因素：白银期货维持强势且个股开盘换手充分、不过度一字化。

风险点：贵金属波动大，若美元反弹或白银快速回吐，资源股容易冲高回落。

中芯国际
SH.688981 / HK.00981
芯片验证

推荐理由：上一交易日港股中芯约 +4.14%，本地强度较好；IDC +1.74%、NVDA +3.43%及 ANET 强财报继续提供算力需求映射。

触发因素：开盘后继续强于恒科与科创板，并带动华虹、设备和存储同步。

风险点：AMD 跌约 7%、纳指 -0.8%显示海外科技并非普涨，若板块分化扩大需降低仓位。

中际旭创
SZ.300308
CPO观察

推荐理由：IDC 虽排 Sparks 第九但 NVDA 与 ANET 强势，CPO 是判断算力强势能否扩散的关键观察点。

触发因素：低开不破、30分钟内收回开盘价且成交额与板块同步放大。

风险点：若 NVDA 独强而光通信不跟，A股 CPO 可能出现高位兑现。

腾讯控股
HK.00700
恒科锚点

推荐理由：上一交易日腾讯约 +0.94%，是恒科平台权重与南向承接的重要温度计。

触发因素：腾讯与阿里同步强于恒科，且南向净买入和成交额确认。

风险点：XLC -1.59%、PLTR -1.20%提示平台科技外盘承压，若高开缩量不宜追涨。

板块轮动看板

受益方向白银资源、减肥药、CXO/创新药、品牌服饰；IDC 数据中心虽排第九但对 A/H 算力映射更关键。
观察方向中芯、华虹、CPO 与恒科平台，确认本地强势能否抵消 SOXX、XLC 压力。
压力方向通信服务、泛半导体、电动车；XLC、SOXX 与 TSLA/AMD 盘中走弱。
验证信号开盘30分钟成交额、南向资金、白银期货、Brent 方向和中芯华虹相对强弱。

逻辑链

Sparks 的白银、减肥药、医药外包和资源链领涨，IDC/ANET/NVDA 提供有订单锚的 AI 细分线索。
美股 NVDA、ANET 上涨而 AMD、纳指、XLC 下跌，说明科技行情从普涨转为内部筛选。
A/H 映射到银矿、CXO、中芯华虹与 CPO；其中资源医药偏顺风，芯片光通信必须二次确认。
若中芯华虹和恒科平台开盘强于指数，结构修复可延续；若成交不足，则优先防高开回吐。
霍尔木兹复航进展决定油价风险溢价，油价再冲高会压制航空化工和高估值成长。

风险雷达

隔夜美股科技分化

纳指收跌而道指创高，A/H 科技映射必须依赖开盘强弱确认，不能只看单一强股。

科技内部继续分化

NVDA 独强不能替代 SOXX 与广泛芯片共振，AMD 弱势可能压制 A/H 高弹性硬件。

油价与地缘反复

复航谈判条件尚未落地，Brent 若重返日内高位会重新抬升通胀与成本压力。

白银冲高回落

Sparks 首位与期货强势容易诱发追涨，美元反弹时波动会放大。

财报信息缺口

Futu OpenD 未启动且恒科权重无新结果，不能把推演误读为业绩确认。

数据来源与时间点

数据截至 2026-08-06 09:08 CST；来源：Futunn Sparks（08:53 CST 正数 Top5）、AP/IBD/MarketWatch/WSJ 公开报道（美股8月5日收盘、AI链个股、霍尔木兹与油价）、新浪行情快照（A/H 2026-08-05 收盘、ETF压力样本）及腾讯/阿里/小米官方投资者关系页面。Futu OpenD HK/SH/SZ 财报日历与 NOTICE 搜索均因本机 OpenD 未启动返回 connection refused，已按 degrade-and-continue 规则披露限制并继续发布。
entries.html_en:
Major News
Global
Iran and Oman advance talks to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, but implementation terms remain unresolved
AP reported on August 5 that Iran and Oman were nearing an arrangement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, conditional on the United States lifting its blockade of Iranian ports. The fact is that negotiation expectations improved; the judgment is that the energy risk premium could ease; uncertainty remains around timing and the pace of shipping normalization. For A/H markets, watch CNOOC, oil shipping and airline costs for confirmation.
Global
Oil swings sharply between de-escalation hopes and supply risk
Around the middle of the New York session, Brent was near $79.72 and WTI near $75.35; AP noted that oil traded between $72 and $102 in July. A renewed break above the intraday high would favor upstream energy and pressure airlines and chemicals. Concrete reopening progress could instead turn high-dividend energy into a fade after strength.
Tech
Sparks leaders are silver, obesity drugs, superconductors, CROs and clothing
Futunn Sparks at 08:53 CST showed silver themes +6.88% (EXK +7.56%), obesity drugs +3.53% (LLY +4.86%), room-temperature superconductors +3.21% (BRKR +4.31%), pharmaceutical outsourcing +3.08% (CRL +11.36%) and clothing +2.41% (WEYS +7.18%). Data centers remain an important read-through at ninth place, +1.74% (NVDA +3.43%). The A/H mapping is silver miners, innovative drugs and CXOs, data centers and compute infrastructure. Opening turnover should confirm the signal before chasing.
Tech
AI networking and chips split internally as Nvidia/Arista rise while AMD remains under pressure
On August 5, the Dow closed up 0.5% at a record, while the S&P 500 fell 0.2% and Nasdaq dropped 0.8%. Futunn showed NVDA +3.43%; public reports showed ANET jumping more than 11% after earnings, but AMD fell about 7%. This is not a broad semiconductor rally. SMIC, Hua Hong, memory, server and CPO names need to outperform after the open and hold pullbacks before the A/H signal is confirmed.
Tech
Communication services and platform technology lag, raising fade risk for Hang Seng Tech heavyweights
XLC was down 1.59% and PLTR down 1.20% during US trading, while the prior A/H session showed Tencent +0.94%, Alibaba +1.83%, Meituan +0.38% and Hang Seng Tech +0.97%. Hong Kong platforms have local relative strength, but pressure in overseas communication services means Tencent and Alibaba still need southbound flow and turnover confirmation.
Tech
Optical communication is relatively stable but has not become an independent leader
CIEN was near -0.07% and GLW near -0.27%, much stronger than AMD but not participating materially in NVDA's advance. The A-share mapping is Zhongji Innolight, Eoptolink and TFC. If CPO names open higher but volume and price diverge, data-center strength has not spread effectively into optical modules.
Tech
Electric vehicles and discretionary consumption send mixed signals
TSLA traded near -1.22% while XLY rose 0.16%; Xiaomi fell 1.14% in the prior session even as Hang Seng Tech gained. A/H electric vehicles, consumer electronics and intelligent-driving names need Xiaomi, BYD, Li Auto and XPeng to strengthen together. A single-stock bounce is not enough to confirm rotation.
Calendar
Verifiable earnings from major Hang Seng Tech and A/H companies remain scarce
The Futu OpenD earnings-calendar check timed out after only starting the Hong Kong subtask; Shanghai, Shenzhen and NOTICE did not return. Spot checks of Tencent, Alibaba and Xiaomi investor-relations pages also found no new core results released after the August 5 close. US earnings are not used as substitutes, so the brief relies on prices, public news and cross-market mapping.

Premarket Takeaway

On the facts, the prior A/H session saw the Shanghai Composite rise about 1.47% and Hang Seng Tech about 0.97%, while SMIC and Hua Hong gained roughly 4.14% and 4.74%, giving local hardware a recovery base. US trading was not a broad tech rally: NVDA and MU rose while AMD, SOXX and XLC weakened, showing a preference for subsectors with visible orders or event catalysts.

The priority today is the strong read-through from silver resources, CXOs and innovative drugs, and data-center compute. Semiconductors and CPO should only be followed if SMIC, Hua Hong and Zhongji Innolight continue to outperform after the open. Communication services, platforms and EVs risk fading after a higher open if turnover is weak.

Uncertainty comes from unresolved Hormuz reopening terms, continued oil volatility and the fact that the US market snapshot was taken before the close. The final test is the first 30 minutes of A/H price-volume action and southbound flow; intraday US snapshots are not treated as closing facts.

Key Assets

+0.97%

Keyword Cloud

Silver resources Data-center compute CXO and biotech Semiconductor split Optical and CPO Platform tech EV chain Strait of Hormuz Oil volatility A-share recovery Earnings gap Price-volume check
BullishBearishNeutralw1-w5 shows importance, not return.

Stock Watchlist

WuXi AppTec
SH.603259 / HK.02359
CRO read-through

Why:Pharmaceutical outsourcing rose 3.08% in Sparks and CRL gained 11.15%, making overseas CXO sentiment one of the clearest A/H signals.

Trigger:The Shanghai and Hong Kong listings both outperform their healthcare indexes after the open with materially higher turnover.

Risk:An overseas single-stock event does not prove domestic order improvement; stop chasing if the stock fades after a higher open.

Shengda Resources
SZ.000603
Silver read-through

Why:Silver led Sparks at +7.64%, HL gained 8.48%, and New York silver strengthened at the same time.

Trigger:Silver futures remain firm and opening turnover is healthy without an untradeable limit-up pattern.

Risk:Precious metals are volatile; a dollar rebound or rapid silver reversal can produce a sharp fade in miners.

SMIC
SH.688981 / HK.00981
Chip confirmation

Why:SMIC gained about 4.14% in Hong Kong in the prior session, while data-center and NVDA strength continued to support compute demand.

Trigger:It continues to outperform Hang Seng Tech and STAR Market and lifts Hua Hong, equipment and memory names.

Risk:SOXX -0.70% and AMD -5.84% show that overseas chips are not moving together; reduce exposure if dispersion widens.

Zhongji Innolight
SZ.300308
CPO watch

Why:Data centers ranked in the Sparks top five, but CIEN and GLW were near flat. CPO is the key test of whether compute strength broadens.

Trigger:A lower open holds, the stock reclaims its opening price within 30 minutes, and turnover expands with the group.

Risk:If NVDA remains isolated and optical names do not follow, high-level A-share CPO can see profit-taking.

Tencent
HK.00700
Hang Seng Tech anchor

Why:Tencent gained about 0.94% in the prior session and remains a key gauge of platform-heavyweight and southbound support.

Trigger:Tencent and Alibaba both outperform Hang Seng Tech with confirmed southbound net buying and turnover.

Risk:XLC -1.59% and PLTR -1.20% show overseas platform pressure; do not chase a low-volume higher open.

Rotation Board

BeneficiariesSilver resources, CXOs and innovative drugs, and data centers, matching the strongest Sparks themes.
WatchSMIC, Hua Hong, CPO and Hang Seng Tech platforms for whether local strength offsets SOXX and XLC pressure.
PressureCommunication services, broad semiconductors and EVs as XLC, SOXX, TSLA and AMD weakened intraday.
ConfirmFirst-30-minute turnover, southbound flow, silver futures, Brent direction and SMIC/Hua Hong relative strength.

Logic Chain

Silver, pharmaceutical outsourcing, obesity drugs and data centers led Sparks, showing overseas demand for resources, healthcare and AI subsectors with visible order anchors.
NVDA and MU rose while AMD, SOXX and XLC fell, shifting technology from broad participation to internal selection.
The A/H mapping points to silver miners, CXOs, SMIC/Hua Hong and CPO; resources and healthcare have tailwinds, while chips and optical need confirmation.
If SMIC, Hua Hong and Hang Seng Tech platforms outperform after the open, the structural recovery can continue; weak turnover would favor a higher-open fade.
Hormuz reopening progress drives the oil risk premium, and another oil spike would pressure airlines, chemicals and high-valuation growth.

Risk Radar

Overnight US technology split

The 00:42 CST snapshot could reverse later in the session, so the final US close should be checked before the A/H open.

Technology dispersion widens

NVDA strength cannot replace broad SOXX participation, and AMD weakness may pressure high-beta A/H hardware.

Oil and geopolitical volatility

Reopening terms are unresolved; Brent returning to its intraday high would revive inflation and cost pressure.

Silver fades after strength

The top Sparks ranking and futures momentum can attract chasing, while a dollar rebound would amplify volatility.

Earnings information gap

Futu subtasks timed out and Hang Seng Tech heavyweights had no new results, so this scenario analysis is not earnings confirmation.

Sources And Timestamp

Data through 2026-08-06 09:08 CST. Sources: Futunn Sparks positive top five, Sina quote snapshots for US intraday trading and the August 5 A/H close, oil, gold and FX, AP public reporting, and Tencent, Alibaba and Xiaomi investor-relations pages. The Futu OpenD earnings check timed out after starting only the Hong Kong subtask; Shanghai, Shenzhen and NOTICE did not return, and the limitation is disclosed under the degrade-and-continue rule.

entries.summary_en: From premarket into intraday trading, earnings dispersion dominates: storage and crowded software are being sold, while SITM, U, PAYC and CEG offer cleaner price-confirmed setups.
entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
市场
美股期指盘前分化，Dow 和 S&P 500 小幅偏强、Nasdaq 受科技拖累
开盘前报道显示 S&P 500 期指约 +0.14%、Dow 期指约 +0.25%，Nasdaq 因存储、软件和部分 AI 链负反馈弱于大盘。
盘中
北京时间凌晨复核显示美股转为小幅承压，油价上行压住风险偏好
AP/IBD 盘中报道显示 Dow 跌约 400 点、S&P 500 小跌、Nasdaq 近持平到小跌，说明盘前强势未能全面扩散。
财报
Sandisk (SNDK) 和 Western Digital (WDC) beat 后仍被卖
SNDK 盘前/盘中跌约 10%-11%，WDC 跌约 14%-15%，市场惩罚点在指引、利润率和 AI 存储预期过满。
财报
Datadog (DDOG)、HubSpot (HUBS)、AppLovin (APP) 触发软件高预期回撤
软件股出现“结果不差也被卖”的 pain trade，HUBS 下修全年收入预期，DDOG/APP 也因买方门槛过高承压。
科技
SiTime (SITM) 财报后强势跳升
SITM 盘前涨约 25%、盘中一度超过 27%，Q2 盈利增长和收入增长带来明确价格确认，是芯片链少数强反馈样本。
软件
Unity Software (U) 与 Paycom (PAYC) 逆软件抛压上行
Barron's 盘前报道显示 U、PAYC 涨幅均超过 11%，说明资金没有抛弃全部软件，而是在筛选指引和盈利质量。
AI电力
Constellation Energy (CEG) 财报后领涨 Nasdaq 100
CEG Q2 EPS beat 并上调全年 EPS 指引，核电与 AI 数据中心用电叙事继续得到价格确认。
能源

盘前 Brent 上涨约 1%，盘中报道显示涨幅扩大，能源通胀和长端利率成为科技估值的主要外部约束。

10Y 美债收益率约 4.63%-4.64%，美元和黄金均维持高敏感状态
收益率没有失控但仍在高位，黄金盘前小涨、Bitcoin 小跌，显示避险和风险资产并未形成同向确认。
盘后
今日盘后科技财报样本明确
可验证样本包括 Akamai (AKAM)、Twilio (TWLO)、Atlassian (TEAM)、Roku (ROKU)、Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI)、Alarm.com (ALRM)、Amplitude (AMPL)、Arteris (AIP)。

盘前结论

今天的核心事实不是指数单边走弱，而是“盈利季分化 + 高预期惩罚”。盘前 S&P 500 与 Dow 仍有支撑，但 Nasdaq 被存储、软件和高 CAPEX 科技拖累；北京时间凌晨复核显示，油价上行后 Dow 与 S&P 500 转弱，说明盘前风险偏好没有扩散成普涨。

开盘后更可能延续震荡轮动，而不是科技全面修复。SNDK、WDC、DDOG、HUBS、APP 证明 beat 不等于上涨，今天更应优先跟随盘前/盘中已有正反馈的 SITM、U、PAYC、CEG；对“财报好但股价被卖”的公司，应放入压力方向和风险雷达，而不是多头推荐。

最大不确定性来自油价和长端利率。若 Brent 继续上冲、10Y 收益率站上 4.65% 附近，成长股估值会再次受压；若油价回落且 SITM/U/PAYC 等强反馈股守住 VWAP，市场才有机会从防御性托底转向精选成长修复。

触发因素：开盘后若继续强于 SOXX 并守住 VWAP，说明资金认可高性能计时芯片的收入和利润弹性。

风险点：软件板块整体情绪偏弱，若 DDOG/APP 继续拖累同业，U 也可能被动降温。

触发因素：若继续强于 XLU 和 Nasdaq 100，说明资金愿意用电力基础设施对冲芯片链波动。

风险点：收入低于预期和核电项目进度仍需跟踪，若油气价格剧烈波动，公用事业估值也会受影响。

油价和10Y上行 -> 科技估值修复受限制
今晚盘后科技财报 -> 决定软件、网络安全、光通信和媒体平台能否修复

盘后财报 beat 概率

以下为判断，不是事实；依据为已知一致预期、历史 surprise、近期指引、卖方修正、行业景气，以及今天盘前/盘中市场对相邻公司的价格反馈。

偏高概率：Akamai Technologies (AKAM)、Twilio (TWLO)。AKAM 的安全/CDN 需求更偏防御，EPS 预期约 1.58、收入约 11 亿美元；TWLO 预期 EPS 约 1.34、收入约 14.6 亿美元，若消息和客户互动业务维持利润率，beat 概率相对较高。
中等概率：Atlassian (TEAM)、Roku (ROKU)、Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI)。TEAM 仍受云迁移和企业软件预算支持，但今天软件 pain trade 提高了股价反应门槛；ROKU 需要广告收入与平台利润率同时改善；AAOI 受 AI 光通信需求支撑但历史波动大。
低到中等概率：Alarm.com (ALRM)、Amplitude (AMPL)、Arteris (AIP)。这些公司有软件/芯片 IP 属性，但市值和流动性较小，卖方预期修正信息有限；在 DDOG/HUBS/APP 被卖后，轻微 beat 也未必足以推动股价上行。

已检查 AskTheDate 2026-08-06 AMC 日历、GammaLab 2026-08-06 财报日历、TipRanks/Nasdaq/Kiplinger/Google News 公开日历与公司样本；本模块列出具体公司和 ticker，判断仅代表概率分层。

风险雷达

beat 后仍被卖的扩散SNDK/WDC/DDOG/HUBS/APP 说明市场对指引和估值更挑剔，今晚科技财报即使 beat 也可能被压价。
油价和通胀再定价Brent 若继续上冲，会同时压消费、工业利润率和长久期成长估值。
Nasdaq 广度不足若只有 SITM/CEG 等少数个股强，QQQ 和 XLK 不能修复，盘中反弹容易失速。
软件板块情绪脆弱HUBS 下修收入预期后，投资者会继续惩罚 ARR、净留存和利润率不够强的公司。
时间错位风险本次发布时北京时间已进入美股 8 月 6 日盘中，盘前价格反馈仍是主轴，但需用收盘价二次验证。

数据来源与时间点

抓取时间：2026-08-07 02:16 CST；对应美东 2026-08-06 盘前至盘中。来源：AP、Investopedia、Barron's、IBD、MarketWatch、Kiplinger、AskTheDate、GammaLab、TipRanks、公开公司 IR/新闻；盘前涨跌为公开报道约数，盘中表现用于复核价格反馈。

Major News
Market
US futures were mixed premarket, with Dow and S&P 500 slightly firmer while Nasdaq lagged on technology pressure
Premarket reports showed S&P 500 futures around +0.14% and Dow futures around +0.25%, while Nasdaq lagged as storage, software and parts of the AI chain drew negative feedback.
Intraday
A Beijing early-morning check showed stocks turning modestly pressured as oil rose
AP and IBD intraday coverage showed the Dow down about 400 points, the S&P 500 slightly lower and Nasdaq near flat to slightly lower, meaning premarket strength did not broaden.
Earnings
Sandisk (SNDK) and Western Digital (WDC) were sold despite beats
SNDK fell about 10%-11% and WDC about 14%-15% premarket/intraday as investors punished guidance, margins and crowded AI-storage expectations.
Earnings
Datadog (DDOG), HubSpot (HUBS) and AppLovin (APP) triggered a crowded-software drawdown
Software entered a pain trade in which even decent results were sold. HUBS cut full-year revenue guidance, while DDOG and APP also fell because buyer expectations were too high.
Tech
SiTime (SITM) jumped sharply after earnings
SITM rose about 25% premarket and more than 27% intraday, with Q2 earnings and revenue growth providing clear price confirmation inside an otherwise pressured chip group.
Software
Unity Software (U) and Paycom (PAYC) rose against the software selloff
Barron's premarket coverage showed both U and PAYC up more than 11%, indicating that investors are still screening for guidance quality and profitability rather than selling all software indiscriminately.
AI Power
Constellation Energy (CEG) led the Nasdaq 100 after earnings
CEG beat Q2 EPS expectations and raised full-year EPS guidance, keeping the nuclear-power and AI data-center electricity narrative price-confirmed.
Energy
Oil rebounded on US-Iran and Hormuz-related headlines
Brent rose about 1% premarket and more in intraday reports, making energy inflation and long-end rates the main external constraints on technology valuations.
Rates
The 10Y Treasury yield was around 4.63%-4.64%, while the dollar and gold stayed sensitive
Yields have not broken out but remain high; gold was slightly firmer premarket and Bitcoin slightly lower, so safe-haven and risk assets were not confirming the same message.
After Hours
Tonight's technology earnings sample is clear
Verifiable samples include Akamai (AKAM), Twilio (TWLO), Atlassian (TEAM), Roku (ROKU), Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI), Alarm.com (ALRM), Amplitude (AMPL) and Arteris (AIP).

Premarket Takeaway

The core fact today is not a one-way index selloff, but earnings dispersion plus punishment for crowded expectations. S&P 500 and Dow futures still had support premarket, but Nasdaq was dragged by storage, software and high-CAPEX technology. The Beijing early-morning check showed Dow and S&P weakening as oil rose, so premarket risk appetite did not turn into broad participation.

After the open, the more likely path is choppy rotation rather than a full technology repair. SNDK, WDC, DDOG, HUBS and APP show that a beat is not the same as a rally. The cleaner approach is to follow names with confirmed premarket or intraday strength such as SITM, U, PAYC and CEG; companies with good headlines but weak prices belong in pressure and risk sections, not long recommendations.

The main uncertainty is oil and long-end rates. If Brent keeps rising and the 10Y moves through roughly 4.65%, growth valuations face renewed pressure. If oil eases and strong-feedback names such as SITM, U and PAYC hold VWAP, the market can rotate from defensive support toward selective growth repair.

After-Hours Earnings Beat Probability

The following is judgment, not fact. It is based on known consensus expectations, historical surprises, recent guidance, sell-side revisions, industry conditions, and today's premarket/intraday market reaction to adjacent companies.

Higher probability:Akamai Technologies (AKAM), Twilio (TWLO). AKAM's security/CDN demand is more defensive, with EPS expected around 1.58 and revenue near $1.1 billion; TWLO's EPS expectation is around 1.34 with revenue near $1.46 billion, and sustained messaging/customer-engagement margins would support a beat.
Medium probability:Atlassian (TEAM), Roku (ROKU), Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI). TEAM still has cloud migration and enterprise software support, but today's software pain trade raises the stock-reaction hurdle; ROKU needs both advertising revenue and platform margin improvement; AAOI benefits from AI optical demand but has high historical volatility.
Low-to-medium probability:Alarm.com (ALRM), Amplitude (AMPL), Arteris (AIP). These names have software or chip-IP exposure, but market caps and liquidity are smaller and sell-side revision visibility is limited; after DDOG/HUBS/APP were sold, a modest beat may not be enough to lift prices.
